props.note: A neat stack of split cedar and fig logs between four corner stakes, for the courtyard's wood store.
A shallow bronze pan on a low stand holding a mound of grey ash, for clearing the altar.
A round coiled-straw carrying basket with two small loops.
A plain low bench: two limestone ends and a cedar seat of two boards.
A tall bronze lamp stand with a small oil bowl on top; unlit mesh.
A large clay water jar with two handles, resting in a ring on three wooden legs, for the laver area.
A tall cedar pole with a crossbar and a linen hanging with a blue hem band; the cloth hangs free so it can sway in the wind.
